title: Bounded advisory change-impact report
intent: Expose evidenced source, CLI-registry and test consumers that import-only retrieval misses, without treating an incomplete dependency view as acceptance authority. Source: three-pillars assessment and GHI #1052 measurement.
decision:
Operator g0: "pool, not feature." Preserve the reviewed GHI #1053 design as an unimplemented backlog proposal. Operator selected "A" for GHI #1029: retain broad proof currency.

Agent-authored synthesis of the reviewed GHI #1053 design. Operator words are quoted explicitly; other text is design analysis, not fabricated verbatim answers.

The agent requested a feature ADR. Operator g0: "pool, not feature." The agent redundantly asked about downstream boundaries. Operator g0: "you are creating a pool ADR, what about that is confusing to you?" The agent proceeded with the explicit pool instruction. Earlier, g0 selected "A" for retaining broad proof currency under #1029.
alternatives: Import-only view omits measured registry and subprocess consumers. A general semantic graph lacks bounded independent authority. Narrowing proof currency with this report is rejected by its advisory scope and the separate #1029 ruling.
positive_consequences: Preserves measured findings, reviewed contract, semantic controls and unknowns in a registered destination without prematurely scheduling a capability.
negative_consequences: No impact capability ships; current discovery limitations and review costs remain. The stored design can age and must be reassessed before promotion.
checklist: Pool scope only: snapshot and coverage accounting; source imports; registry witness chains; test import/subprocess witnesses; complete text/JSON population; independent real-case validation. These are candidate scope components, not OBPI checklist commitments.
pre_mortem: An apparently short report is mistaken for proof that omitted consumers cannot exist; unsupported relationship types and stale capture remain hidden. Preserve per-type evidence and gaps; never confer completion authority.
wwhtbt: Typed sections must recover measured omissions while remaining reviewable in real cases. Import-only would be preferable only if those missing relationships ceased to matter or were reliably supplied elsewhere; the existing measurement contradicts that condition for its sampled cases.
constraint_archaeology: ADR-0.37.0 Alternative 2 requires a measured reviewable bound. Human timing is a proposed evaluation method, not an immutable upstream requirement. Existing campaign sequence and independent acceptance authority remain in force.
assumption_surfacing: Assumes witnessed consumers reduce omissions enough to justify review effort. Counts are proxies, not human benefit. If typed output only adds noise, revise or decline promotion rather than hide a tail.
operator_2am: Need the exact selected paths, scanned roster, producer identity, source locations, failures and unsupported relationships so an empty or misleading result can be diagnosed.
reversibility: Pooling commits no runtime contract. A later advisory query can be removed without rewriting proof identity or completion history; retaining this boundary makes reversal local.
scope_minimization: Minimum useful proposal includes source imports, complete known-registry chains and test consumers together, with capture and gap accounting. Import-only repeats the measured false-empty case.
downstream_adrs: Pool status carries no implementation commitment. Any later promotion and implementation follow normal campaign and feature/OBPI governance, retaining the documented reviewability condition. Proof currency remains broad under the separately recorded #1029 ruling.
